notes: S2-FIX4 F83 guard (§11.3 T17/A-L8, §5.3): the manifest is signed by a human key whose only declaration carries only its own signature. The declaration has no other signature, so it supplies its material although it is untrusted (E_KEY_UNTRUSTED, N_SELF_ATTESTED_ROOT_KEY): the manifest entry's key resolves, the equation verifies with context material (L_KEY_TRUST_TOFU) and the container reports no E_KEY_UNKNOWN. Only a declaration whose other signature does not pass supplies no material (container/manifest-signer-declaration-*).
